svg.aria-label: Two time-course panels comparing the full mass-action simulation with the reduced Michaelis-Menten solution. In the valid regime the two are indistinguishable; in the violating regime they separate widely.

g.text: ET/(KM+S0) = 0.008 — reduced curve lies on top
solid and dashed differ by under 0.4 percent
the complex reaches quasi-steady state within 1 s
dashed: reduced Michaelis-Menten (1 ODE), KM = 2 µM
